title: Inspector, Anchors Preset doesn't update current preset
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.7.rc1.official [a4f5e8cdd]
v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.7.rc1 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In the inspector, layout, anchors preset, choosing the current preset doesn't update the anchors.

The current preset would be chosen again when:
Centering a node
Resizing it
Centering it again

### Steps to reproduce

- Open project: [inspector-anchor-preset-doesn't-update-current-preset.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28798976/inspector-anchor-preset-doesn.t-update-current-preset.zip)
- In the scene panel, select: ColorRect
Note:
The ColorRect's default size is: 40x40
it was centered with the anchors preset: Center
then its width was increased from 40 to 100
- In the inspector, layout, anchor presets, choose the current preset: Center

### Issue
Nothing happens.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/253bb50e-6e6d-49fc-a0b1-42e2c0a45e33

### Expected
Update the inspector's current anchor preset, like it does from the viewport's toolbar popup: Anchor preset

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad164de1-ebe1-43cb-91db-422eff23530a

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[inspector-anchor-preset-doesn't-update-current-preset.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28798976/inspector-anchor-preset-doesn.t-update-current-preset.zip)
